name: translate-fr
summary: Translate an English operational summary and structured facts into French, echoing structured_facts and a summary_or_translation field for linear chain composition.
description: Fourth node of the report.* chain. Model-free EN→FR translation: PROJECT phrase templates (combines distributed browser / shows how adaptive summarization) fill PROJECT and N placeholders; Fact lines use case-sensitive exact template match; otherwise ordered glossary substitution. 1.1.0 additionally echoes structured_facts verbatim (the original English facts) and emits summary_or_translation set to the French translated_summary, so report.format can draw both of its inputs from this single predecessor on the French path under browserLocalPlan's linear chain search (registry#441). Inputs and translation logic unchanged from 1.0.0. Pure, deterministic, memory-only.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a named project summary translated with filled placeholders while the original structured facts and a language-agnostic summary_or_translation field are carried alongside, so that report.format can consume everything from this one node on the French path.

input_example.summary: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights.

output_example.translated_summary: Acme Rollout combine des preuves distribuees du navigateur, de l'edge et du cloud dans un resume operationnel deterministe avec 2 observation(s) validee(s).
output_example.summary_or_translation: Acme Rollout combine des preuves distribuees du navigateur, de l'edge et du cloud dans un resume operationnel deterministe avec 2 observation(s) validee(s).

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want an exact Fact template translated verbatim, so that known enrichment lines stay consistent across locales.

structured_facts: Fact: An edge cache exposes regional rollout data with low latency.
Fact: An edge cache exposes regional rollout data with low latency.
translated_facts: Fait : un cache edge expose les donnees de deploiement regional avec une faible latence.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want unknown phrasing to fall back to glossary substitution rather than inventing text, so that partial translations remain deterministic and honest.

input_example.summary: Fact: browser telemetry and low latency matter.

output_example.translated_summary: Fait : telemetrie du navigateur and faible latence matter.
output_example.summary_or_translation: Fait : telemetrie du navigateur and faible latence matter.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies summary string and structured_facts array (either may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields identical translated_summary and translated_facts. Template matching and glossary substitution use no randomness, clocks, embeddings, or host state.

side_effects.description: Produces translated strings in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.

provenance.author: enricopiovesan
provenance.spec_ref: registry#441 (browser chain linear pass-through) / registry#426 report chain port

authoring.test_evidence: capability-src/report-translate-fr: 14 #[test] cases covering PROJECT combines/shows-how templates, placeholder fill, exact Fact template, glossary-only, passthrough, empty string, plus the 1.1.0 structured_facts echo and summary_or_translation = translated_summary; cargo llvm-cov functions=100%, lines=100%, regions=100%.
